_doc: Trigger-eval описания deepdive; прогон — ~/.claude/scripts/skill_trigger_eval.py (платно, без явной просьбы не запускать). Лежит в evals/, не в eval/ (там бенчмарк качества отчётов). Near-miss негативы: общие слова с соседом (исследуй/разбери/изучи/как устроен), но место соседа.

competitors.name: claude-api
competitors.description: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration. TRIGGER whenever the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form, the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching), or the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated.

competitors.name: deep-research
competitors.description: Use this skill when the user's prompt requires researching a topic across multiple sources, comparing options or alternatives, analyzing trends or history, understanding markets or industries, or reviewing literature or studies and synthesizing that research into a comprehensive, narrative report.
